title: Single-use Bureau runtime refresh after PR #2258 legacy verification disposition
goal: Publish exactly one initially non-executable planned Bureau runtime-refresh authority through a protected one-file PR, adopt it missing-only into authoritative StateStore, and only then activate it by a proof-bearing planned-to-ready CAS. Its sole purpose is to converge the installed Bureau runtime and canonical Registry from f5fc1e9402ac618a80d4252d27179d7a2d009171 to a freshly observed protected-main successor containing merged PR #2258 and this authority publication, so the legacy verified-disposition mechanism is live. This authority performs no legacy TaskSpec disposition itself.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound Bureau runtime/Registry convergence only after merged PR #2258. The authority may install one freshly observed protected-main successor derived from deployed source f5fc1e9402ac618a80d4252d27179d7a2d009171 after its own protected one-file publication and proof-bearing StateStore activation. It grants no legacy TaskSpec disposition, queue, claim, dispatch, unrelated repository, foreign-work or broad cleanup authority. Any failed, unclear or transport-ambiguous runtime effect is reconstructed before further action; no blind retry.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, heimgewebe/bureau main is freshly observed. The exact target contains merged PR #2258, this authority publication, and all legitimate intermediate protected-main merges; validate (3.10), validate (3.12), and registry-registration-preflight/freshness are successful for the exact target context. Any main, PR, check, target, source/manifest, or authority drift invalidates older observations and intents.

Before prepare-intent and again before apply, deployment-manifest source and canonical Registry source are identity-valid and equal. The registered deployed source f5fc1e9402ac618a80d4252d27179d7a2d009171 is freshly proven as a Git ancestor of the selected protected-main target. Mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof, or target drift blocks fail-closed.

Before any runtime effect, authoritative StateStore exposes this exact task ID on a proof-bearing ready revision later than the initial missing-only adopted planned revision. That revision binds metadata.protected_publication_adoption to the real publication PR and merge commit and atomically adds the protected-publication-and-missing-only-adoption acceptance plus no-run evidence binding.

This authority starts at most one Bureau runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout, or transport-ambiguous outcomes are reconstructed from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, Registry, task lifecycle, and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry or foreign authority substitution is permitted.

After successful apply, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launchers, scheduler artifacts, and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed protected-main source commit. StateStore integrity and Bureau runtime identity are valid, and the installed source contains merged PR #2258 with the legacy verified-disposition mechanism.

The authority is consumed at most once and grants only Bureau runtime/Registry convergence needed to make merged PR #2258 live. It grants no legacy TaskSpec disposition or classification decision, no queue, claim, dispatch or task-supply authority, no unrelated repository mutation, no foreign-work authority, and no broad cleanup effect.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime at f5fc1e9402ac618a80d4252d27179d7a2d009171 remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. If publication/adoption, source ancestry, target freshness, CI, StateStore binding, execution-context writability, lease binding, or runtime effect becomes unclear, preserve all evidence and do not retry; reconciliation requires a separately authorized successor path.

metadata.source: Merged Bureau PR #2258 introduced the legacy verified-disposition mechanism at protected main 61a671df7c353fc56cf73861479115219827067a while the installed Bureau runtime and canonical Registry remain identity-valid at f5fc1e9402ac618a80d4252d27179d7a2d009171. Fresh runtime-refresh observation 8c1666661a70db4e1eabb4f5e3c665e07c3147c41807e209eae19e267be99fb4 proves f5fc1e9402ac618a80d4252d27179d7a2d009171 is the merge base/ancestor of protected main 61a671df7c353fc56cf73861479115219827067a with all required checks green. A new purpose-bound single-use authority is required because existing unbound authorities are either source-precondition-bound to older deployed source fd9570... or purpose-specific.

publication_path.reason: Installed Bureau runtime/Registry predates merged PR #2258. Existing historical authorities are not reused because their source or purpose bindings differ. The publication grants no disposition effect.
